summary: Describes how Mobile IPv6 bootstrapping uses a Diameter Network Access Server to interact with Diameter servers, so home agent address, home address and security details can be provided dynamically through existing AAA infrastructure. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: A traveling device needs a home address and a key before it can start. This lets it get them from the same login system the network already uses.

questions: diameter nas to aaa for mipv6
